Name: Shrimp Shirt Bug Fix - DEPRECATED BY SDV 1.4.4
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Now obsolete - A tiny bug fix until the official game updates.  Fixes the shrimp shirt to show the correct sprite.
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A small fix for a typo in the game, allowing the shrimp shirt to actually use the correct sprite!  Thanks to Megan#8529 for pointing it out on the Discord server!  The preview image is of their farmer.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work!

Obviously only for SDV 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.  Deprecated as of SDV 1.4.4, but I will leave it up as an example mod.

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Shrimp Shirt Bug Fix' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game!
